dance_extended_recipe.how: Generate 7 or 8 consecutive clips, feeding the last clean frame of the previous clip as the next clip starting frame; enforce shared identity, camera pose, costume and room. Match beat at edit points. Where a model supports 20-30 seconds of stable generation, generate fewer longer segments.
dance_extended_recipe.dance_transition: slow down last move => neutral balanced stance => smoothly accelerate into next move; avoid hard cuts and jump poses.

metadata.live_stream_note: These are prerecorded or rendered motion clips, not proof of real-time 3D; the live site needs a server-side event queue + single canonical stream shared by viewers and text-chat orchestration.
metadata.audio_notes: Keyboard SFX should be played only during visible real typing via frontend events. Music must be user-owned, cleared, licensed or genuinely royalty-free. Crossfade music during idle and boost moderately for dances; obey browser autoplay limits.
